en.title: hood
en.summary: The engine cover — the bonnet in British and Australian usage. Its release cable and its support strut are both things that fail quietly and are noticed at the worst moment.

es.title: capó
es.summary: La tapa del motor. Su cable de apertura y su amortiguador de sostén son de esas piezas que fallan calladas y se notan en el peor momento.
